name: Health and fitness
summary: BMI, calories, heart-rate zones, running pace and water intake
author: friday-core
description: Fitness arithmetic with the formulas shown, as guidance and never as medical advice. It holds 5 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. BMI: Body mass index with WHO and Asia-Pacific bands and the healthy weight range. Calories: Basal rate (Mifflin-St Jeor), daily needs by activity and a protein range. Heart-rate zones: Zones from age (Tanaka) or from a measured maximum, with Karvonen when resting pulse is given. Running pace: Pace and speed from distance and time, and race-time predictions (Riegel). Water intake: A daily water guide from weight, exercise and heat.
